name: Wazuh Getting Started
account_requirement: Documentation is publicly accessible; platform installation requires suitable compute resources.
hardware_requirement: Reading docs requires a browser. Running the full stack requires more resources; check the official requirements.
access_note: Wazuh is free and open source. Its hosted cloud service is separate and offers a trial, so do not treat that service as permanently free.

name: Splunk Free Courses
account_requirement: Registration may be required for course access.
hardware_requirement: Browser and internet access; hands-on product access may have separate requirements.
access_note: The provider lists free learning opportunities. Product use, certifications, and some labs may have separate conditions.

name: Microsoft Learn
account_requirement: A profile is not required to read training content; sign-in is needed for some profile features.
hardware_requirement: Browser and internet access. Some optional cloud labs need separate Azure resources.
access_note: Training is free. Check carefully before provisioning cloud resources, which may require a subscription and can incur charges.

name: SigmaHQ Detection Rules
account_requirement: A GitHub account is not required to view public content; needed for some contribution workflows.
hardware_requirement: Browser; rule testing/conversion may need local tools.
access_note: Public rule repository. Review its current licence and the requirements and status of individual rules before reusing them.

name: MITRE ATT&CK Resources
account_requirement: Public reference material; no account normally needed to read it.
access_note: A public knowledge base for describing observed adversary behaviour; mapping a technique does not prove an alert is malicious.

name: PortSwigger Web Security Academy
account_requirement: Check the provider's current account requirements for lab progress and tracking.
hardware_requirement: Browser and internet access; some exercises benefit from local web security tools.
access_note: The Academy describes itself as free online training with interactive labs. Use only its intended labs or systems you are authorised to test.

name: OverTheWire Bandit
account_requirement: Use the service's documented SSH connection; review its current rules and instructions.
hardware_requirement: A terminal with SSH capability and internet access.
access_note: A beginner-oriented educational wargame. Stay within the challenge environment and published rules.

name: OWASP Juice Shop
account_requirement: No account needed to read project documentation; local setup has its own requirements.
hardware_requirement: A supported runtime or container environment and sufficient local resources.
access_note: Intentionally vulnerable training application. Run only in a controlled lab you own or are authorised to use; never expose it as a public vulnerable service.

name: TryHackMe Free Rooms
account_requirement: An account is required to use the platform.
hardware_requirement: Browser and internet access; individual rooms may have additional requirements.
access_note: The provider lists selected free rooms; learning paths, rooms, AttackBox time, and other features may have premium restrictions.
